# Copilot instructions

The instructions for coding agents in this repository are in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the
repository root. Read it before planning or changing anything; it lists the commands, the
project decisions, the external sources of truth for APIs, and the git and pull request
conventions.

Claude Code also loads the rules in `.claude/rules/` (rules-for-robots core and `unreal-plugin`
packs, and the project rules `O3D-*`). They apply to Copilot's work in this repository too.
